data.narrative:
Scout AI, a Seed-stage defense and security AI company founded by Colby Adcock and Collin Otis, has raised $15M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers (2 public, 8 private) in the Defense & Security sector, including Stark Defence, UFORCE, Singularity, and NODA AI.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression methodology applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $38M based on the $15M raised as a valuation proxy. Peer-median analysis across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produces $700M, reflecting a wide range from $125M (NODA AI, Series A) to $4.0B (Stark Defence, Series A).

The analysis implies a valuation range of $32M to $805M, with a median of $369M. This wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around Scout AI's stage relative to the peer set. The peer-median method pulls significantly higher, driven by UFORCE's $1.0B Seed valuation as an outlier within the cohort. Stage-progression anchors to company-specific capital raised but assumes standardized step-ups that may not reflect sector-specific risk or market conditions. Key uncertainties include whether early-stage Defense & Security companies sustain the capital multiples observed at later stages, and whether Scout AI's specific technical positioning and customer traction justify positioning toward the upper or lower end of the derived range.
